title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best Auckland gyms by suburb, price and features. Compare gym membership prices and contracts.
intro: Auckland has a wide range of gyms to choose from, with prices starting from $10.99 per week for a basic membership. However, with so many options available, it can be overwhelming to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we will break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb, including their prices and features.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with many options to choose from. Some popular gyms in the CBD include City Fitness, which offers a weekly membership from $19.95, and Les Mills, which offers a weekly membership from $24.95.

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: For those who commute to work, a gym near a major transport hub can be convenient. Jetts Fitness has a gym located near the Auckland train station, with a weekly membership from $14.95. Anytime Fitness also has a gym near the bus station, with a weekly membership from $16.95.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: Parking can be a major consideration when choosing a gym. City Fitness has a car park with 2 hours free parking, while Les Mills has limited street parking available. Jetts Fitness and Anytime Fitness have parking available nearby, but it may incur an additional cost.
